execution_policy.segment_rule: Complete, validate, record, and stop after exactly one M8 sub-segment unless the user explicitly requests another.
execution_policy.safety_rule: Safe build, test, profiling, and read-only commands run automatically. Destructive cleanup or replacement of existing evidence requires separate authorization.
execution_policy.correctness_before_optimization: M8-A2 and M8-A3 must pass before performance tuning. Any optimization must preserve the protected M7 and M8 long-run results.
execution_policy.measurement_rule: Compute-only uses 3 warmups and 20 measured repeats; end-to-end uses 1 warmup and 5 measured repeats. Report median, P95, min, and max.
execution_policy.claim_rule: Kernel-only timing cannot be used to claim end-to-end completion. CPU sequential, CPU process-parallel, GPU compute-only, GPU full, GPU summary, transfer, encoding, I/O, and total wall time are reported separately.
